args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with ~18% error rate. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions. Rollback verified (status: rolled_out).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated** checkout-api: confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: the deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1 was the failing deploy).

3. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all regions — verified successful (status: `rolled_out`).

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.
